items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Willy Jones took me to see him. I didn't know him as well as Willy Jones

ctx.x: Say, riding in a limousine tonight, lookit, Mingus. Willy Jones took me to see him. I didn't know him as well as Willy Jones, because I was playing with the opposite in Philadelphia. And -- what was that bar? Big round bar.
Oh, I know what you mean, I can't think of it.
